instruction: A candid outdoor photograph with a medium-wide shot of friends sitting on the grass under a tree. On the far right, the large man in a dark blue t-shirt (R1) sits laughing while holding a white inflatable bowling pin high. In the center, the bald man in a dark blue t-shirt (R2) sits holding another pin vertically. On the left, the woman in a black beanie (R5) sits in the foreground holding a pin like a guitar, while the woman in a dark blue t-shirt (R4) sits behind her. Natural daylight filters through the trees, casting soft shadows on the green lawn.
